stories.headline: US official reports progress in developing Philippine EDCA sites
stories.summary: A senior US defense official said the two countries had made substantial progress at nine Philippine sites covered by the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement over the past 18 months. The agreement permits US access, construction and equipment prepositioning at designated facilities but excludes permanent basing.

stories.headline: House proposal seeks to double monthly social pension for senior citizens
stories.summary: Makabayan lawmakers filed a measure that would raise the senior citizens' social pension from P1,000 to P2,000 a month. The proposal would extend eligibility to SSS and GSIS pensioners receiving P10,000 or less monthly and provide periodic inflation adjustments.

stories.headline: CHED allocates P56.66 million to continue health-science scholarships
stories.summary: The Commission on Higher Education said it secured P56.66 million to support 238 continuing medical technology and pharmacy scholars and 300 scholars in the first semester of academic year 2026–2027. Recipients must complete government service after passing their licensure examinations.

stories.headline: Marcos expands social-protection access for contract and job-order workers
stories.summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. ordered government agencies to include contract-of-service and job-order workers in available social-protection coverage and provide them information about applicable programs, according to the report.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs lowers 2026 Philippine growth forecast to 3.3 percent
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its Philippine economic growth forecast for 2026 to 3.3 percent, citing inflation and slower remittance growth as constraints, according to the report. The revision adds to recent private-sector downgrades following weaker economic performance.

stories.headline: DFA verifies report that more than 100 Filipinos were detained in China
stories.summary: The Department of Foreign Affairs said the government was verifying the number, status and circumstances of more than 100 Filipinos reportedly detained in China over alleged immigration violations. The agency said Philippine diplomatic posts were seeking information needed to provide consular assistance.

stories.headline: Monsoon rains keep parts of Luzon and western Visayas under flood risk
stories.summary: PAGASA forecast occasional rain in Zambales and Bataan and scattered rain or thunderstorms across Metro Manila and much of Luzon, warning of possible flash floods and landslides. Moderate to rough coastal waters were expected along northern and western Luzon.

stories.headline: UK records hottest day of 2026 as wildfires spread in central England
stories.summary: The United Kingdom recorded a 2026 high of 38.1 degrees Celsius in west London as firefighters battled multiple West Midlands fires that destroyed homes. A child and three firefighters were hospitalized, while France, Greece and other parts of Europe also faced extreme heat and wildfire pressure.
